name: Ember & Olive
tagline: Wood-fired small plates and natural wine in the heart of Cambridge.
intro: A 40-cover restaurant built around a wood-fired grill. The menu changes with the seasons and is made for sharing.
dietaryNote: V vegetarian · VG vegan · GF gluten-free ingredients. Our kitchen handles all 14 major allergens. Please tell your server about any allergies.

about.heading: Cooked over fire, made to share
body: Everything on the menu passes through the grill, from the bread to the cabbage to the quince for dessert.
Our list of low-intervention wines comes mostly from small European growers, with a few English bottles we love.

events.title: Winemaker dinners
events.desc: Five courses paired with one grower’s wines. £65 a head.

privateHire.heading: Private dining & exclusive hire
privateHire.body: Book the chef’s table for up to 10, or the whole restaurant for up to 40. We’ll build a sharing menu around your event.
privateHire.capacity: Chef’s table up to 10 / exclusive hire up to 40

faqs.a: We keep a few seats at the counter for walk-ins every night.
An optional 12.5% service charge goes entirely to the team.
